item:kron-s-amulet.summary: Kron's Amulet is a personal keepsake belonging to Kron, a young orc hunter from Durotar who went missing along the Southfury River.

item:letter-to-ello.summary: The Letter to Ello is a sealed missive penned by Abercrombie, an eccentric hermit dwelling near Beggar's Haunt in Duskwood. Addressed to Mayor Ello Ebonlocke of Darkshire, the letter is delivered under the hermit's claim of old friendship, though its contents are written in an archaic script.

item:lieutenant-s-insignia.summary: A Lieutenant's Insignia is an emblem worn by ranking members of the Burning Blade cult hiding within Durotar. Recovered by Horde adventurers, it serves as crucial evidence of cult activity operating dangerously close to Orgrimmar.

item:muddy-journal-pages.summary: These weathered, soil-stained sheets were recovered from the scene of a gruesome murder years ago in Duskwood. Long preserved by Tavernkeep Smitts without proof of authorship, they remain a key piece of evidence in an unresolved local investigation.

item:rolf-and-malakai-s-medallions.summary: Rolf and Malakai's Medallions are the service tokens of two Stormwind guards who vanished while patrolling eastern Elwynn Forest. Bearing the insignia of the realm, these items are sought by Guard Thomas to determine the fate of his missing comrades.

item:taragaman-the-hungerer-s-heart.summary: Taragaman the Hungerer's Heart is the grisly trophy taken from the felguard presiding over the depths of Ragefire Chasm. Neeru Fireblade requests this foul organ as proof that the demonic presence beneath Orgrimmar has been purged.

item:translated-letter.summary: The Translated Letter is a deciphered message penned by the hermit Abercrombie and translated by Sirra Von'Indi in Darkshire for Mayor Ello Ebonlocke.

npc:andron-gant.summary: Andron Gant is a reclusive, frequently intoxicated Forsaken residing in the murky depths of the Apothecarium in the Undercity, handling occasional research commissions and relic recoveries for local scholars.

npc:braelyn-firehand.summary: Braelyn Firehand is an elven practitioner of the arcane residing quietly among the Horde at Sun Rock Retreat in the Stonetalon Mountains. Claiming an interest in clearing mystical obstructions across the highlands, she enlists travelers to strike against the night elven guardians of Stonetalon Peak.

npc:charlga-razorflank.summary: Charlga Razorflank, widely known as the Crone of the Kraul, is the fierce and cunning geomancer chieftain presiding over Razorfen Kraul. Under her leadership, the Razorfen quilboar drove the tauren out of the southern Barrens through ruthless expansion, claiming to fight in the name of their fallen god, Agamaggan.

npc:gerrig-bonegrip.summary: Gerrig Bonegrip is an unassuming dwarven shopkeeper tucked away in the shadowy corridors of Ironforge's Forlorn Cavern. Behind the counter of Bonegrip's Runes and Dooms, he quietly buys and sells esoteric texts concerning dark rituals and forgotten ancient powers.

npc:high-inquisitor-fairbanks.summary: High Inquisitor Fairbanks was once a revered priest of the Knights of the Silver Hand and a trusted advisor to Highlord Alexandros Mograine. Once a prominent spiritual leader among Lordaeron's surviving defenders, his fate became tied to the dark descent of the Scarlet Crusade.

npc:jitters.summary: Jitters is a trembling, reclusive human hiding out among the ruins of Raven Hill in western Duskwood. Consumed by constant paranoia and fear, he survives alone on Duskwood's perilous western edge, relying on passing adventurers for assistance while watching the encroaching shadows.

npc:keeper-bel-dugur.summary: Keeper Bel'dugur is a scholarly Forsaken residing deep within the Apothecarium of the Undercity. He serves his people by commissioning expeditions to recover dark tomes and magical artifacts from across Azeroth.

npc:lindsay-ravensun.summary: Lindsay Ravensun is a Forsaken operative stationed in the Western Plaguelands, assisting Horde forces and directing recruits in the ongoing campaign for the ruins of Andorhal.

npc:natalia-mar-alith.summary: Mistress Natalia Mar'alith is a night elf priestess and Cenarion Circle researcher who went missing deep within the silithid nests of Hive'Regal. She ventured into the wastes of Silithus alongside her husband, Commander Mar'alith, before departing on an expedition into the hives.

npc:onyxia.summary: Onyxia is the broodmother of the black dragonflight and the devious daughter of Deathwing. Lurking in her wyrm lair within Dustwallow Marsh, she tends to her burgeoning brood while coordinating with her sinister dragonflight to exert dominance over the mortal realms.

npc:rheastrasza.summary: Rhea is a goblin researcher operating in the dusty expanses of the Badlands, employing mortal adventurers to help gather samples and assist with covert operations across the arid canyonlands.

npc:stitches.summary: Stitches is a colossal, stitched-together undead abomination that terrorizes Duskwood. Spawning in the western reaches of the zone, the monster relentlessly marches down the main road toward Darkshire, slaughtering unwary travelers and overwhelming Night Watch checkpoints.

quest:1044.summary: Answered Questions is an Alliance quest concluding a cross-continental investigation into the disappearance of the night elf priestess Velinde Starsong. Following clues across Kalimdor and the Eastern Kingdoms, an adventurer returns to Darnassus to deliver a final report to Thyn'tel Bladeweaver.

quest:142.summary: This critical mission sends adventurers along the dusty roads of Westfall to hunt down a roving Defias Messenger. Intercepting his dispatches allows Gryan Stoutmantle and the People's Militia to uncover vital intelligence regarding the bandit uprising.

quest:1447.summary: This tense confrontation is a pivotal step in unraveling the mystery of the missing diplomat. Following a trail through Stormwind's underbelly, an investigator corners Dashel Stonefist in Old Town to force answers out of the stubborn ruffian.

quest:252.summary: Translation to Ello is a pivotal quest in the Abercrombie storyline in Duskwood. Having asked Sirra Von'Indi to decipher the hermit's cryptic writings, the adventurer is tasked with delivering the translated parchment directly to Lord Ello Ebonlocke in Darkshire.

quest:283.summary: A Dark Threat Looms is an urgent mission to protect Loch Modan from disaster. Alliance adventurers are tasked with deploying a neutralizing chemical against a planted explosive charge before catastrophic damage can be dealt to the Stonewrought Dam.

quest:299.summary: Prospector Whelgar tasks adventurers with venturing into the overrun Whelgar's Excavation Site in the Wetlands to recover four missing pieces of an ancient tablet known as the Goaz Stone so its mysterious inscriptions can be translated.

quest:397.summary: You Have Served Us Well is a warlock quest in Stormwind City. Undertaken on behalf of Zardeth of the Black Claw, warlock practitioners report back to the cabal beneath the Slaughtered Lamb to finalize their service and claim their reward.

quest:434.summary: "The Attack!" is a high-stakes quest in Stormwind Keep involving an undercover operation orchestrated by the gnome tinkerer Tyrion and cheese merchant Elling Trias. Adventurers assist in executing a covert sting within the royal gardens to catch treasonous conspirators red-handed.

quest:440.summary: High Executor Hadrec sends an adventurer to Brill carrying a recovered wedding band inscribed to a woman named Deliah. Magistrate Sevren consults town records to investigate her identity and determine where the ring originated.

quest:453.summary: Finding the Shadowy Figure is an Alliance quest that tasks adventurers with tracking down an elusive stranger connected to the tragedy at Sven Yorgen's farm. Guided by clues from Tavernkeep Smitts in Darkshire, travelers scour the haunted woods to the west in search of the fleeing fugitive.

quest:4813.summary: "The Fragments Within" is the concluding task in the investigation of the mysterious red crystal jutting from the cliffs east of Auberdine. Equipped with purified moonwell water, you are sent back to the site to examine what lies within the strange formation and report back to Sentinel Glynda Nal'Shea.

quest:524.summary: Elixir of Agony is the culmination of Apothecary Lydon's sinister brewing experiments in Tarren Mill. Tasked by the Royal Apothecary Society, Lydon seeks to test a deadly poison disguised as stolen dwarven ale on human prisoners held within the settlement.

quest:590.summary: A Rogue's Deal is a confrontation with Calvin Montague in Deathknell. After offering work to newly awakened Forsaken with the promise of wealth, the sly rogue's true intentions come to light when payment is demanded.

quest:632.summary: Rhag Garmason tasks adventurers with checking on Ol' Ebenezer Rustlocke, a scout sent to inspect the massive stone crossing of the Thandol Span after contact with him is lost. Investigating beneath the arches of the crossing reveals the circumstances surrounding his disappearance and threats to the northern supply lines.

quest:6482.summary: Deep within Thistlefur Hold in northern Ashenvale, a caged bear named Ruul awaits rescue from the corrupted Thistlefur furbolgs. Horde adventurers can assist the captive in fighting his way out of the furbolg den to safety.

quest:71.summary: Report to Thomas is a quest in eastern Elwynn Forest concerning Guard Thomas's investigation into the missing Stormwind guards near the eastern waterways. An adventurer assists Guard Thomas at the eastern bridge by investigating the fate of his missing comrades and reporting back on the situation along the river.

quest:7782.summary: This quest represents the final culmination of the campaign against the forces within Blackrock Mountain. After reporting to Grand Admiral Jes-Tereth in Stormwind Keep, heroes are directed to the Valley of Heroes where Field Marshal Stonebridge coordinates a public commemoration at the city gates for all the Alliance to see.

quest:957.summary: This quest tasks adventurers with helping the trapped spirit of Asterion in the ruins of Bashal'Aran. By carrying his binding seal south to the sister ruins of Ameth'Aran, adventurers seek a way to shatter his ancient bonds.

subzone:mast-room.summary: The Mast Room is a cavernous subterranean lumber mill nestled deep within the Deadmines. Overseen by the goblin taskmaster Sneed and his woodcarvers, this chamber processes timber stripped from Westfall.

subzone:roland-s-doom.summary: Roland's Doom is an abandoned, shadow-drenched mine tucked into the southeastern hills of Duskwood, just east of the Rotting Orchard. Once an ordinary delve, it has become infamous as a dangerous den overrun by savage worgen.

topic:burning-blade-clan.summary: Once an ancient orcish clan renowned for its deadly blademasters and consumed by chaotic frenzy during the early wars, the Burning Blade now largely persists as a sinister demon-worshiping cult. Infiltrating Durotar and the Barrens under the direction of the Shadow Council, its acolytes threaten the fragile peace of the region. Meanwhile, a handful of honorable blademasters have forsaken demonic corruption to serve Warchief Thrall in the New Horde.

topic:juggernaught.summary: A Juggernaught is an enormous, heavily armored battleship bristling with heavy naval cannons. Originally engineered by ogres to serve as the iron core of the Old Horde's fleet during the Second War, these floating fortresses were built to pulverize coastal strongholds and trade routes. Their massive iron plating and siege-grade broadsides make them legendary instruments of naval warfare.

topic:syndicate.summary: The Syndicate is a widespread human criminal organization founded and led by dispossessed nobles of the fallen kingdom of Alterac. Operating out of fortified strongholds across the Alterac Mountains, Hillsbrad Foothills, and the ruins of Stromgarde Keep, they wage an uncompromising war against both the Alliance and the Horde to restore their lost aristocracy.
